answer: Delayed activation with seeded test jobs stops alias farming. A new alias earns nothing for its first 7 days and must complete 3 unpaid test jobs graded blind, passing at least 2 before it can take paid work. The test set includes a wharf inventory count, a horizon photo check, and a lagoon sample log, each with a known correct result. An operator spinning up 50 copies gains nothing fast, since each copy must pass its own test set. Seeded jobs expose copying: identical wrong answers across aliases flag the cluster, and every flagged alias is barred for 30 epochs.
